description: Prepares an order for your user to approve and pay. Returns approvalUrl (give it to the user: they review the terms, consent and pay there; you cannot) and a private token for get_order_status. Nothing is charged until the user pays, and only when the certificate is issued.

files.description: One PDF, or up to 5 JPEG/PNG images of one document in page order. Max 10 MB in total before encoding (base64 in JSON makes it about a third larger; the REST API takes up to 20 MB as a multipart upload).

locale.description: Language of the user's pages and emails (Japanese if omitted), and of this tool's messages (English if omitted)

names.description: Optional, up to 10 people named in the document: added to the translation as a customer-supplied note (names in the translation stay as written)

katakana.description: Its katakana, e.g. as on a residence card

latin.description: A name as written in the document

receiving_procedure.description: Where the translation will be submitted, if known

name: create_order
title: Prepare an order
